messages:
incidents-bot: Pager -> hosted-api-us-east: request-queue growth detected. backlog ~4.2k, p95 1.2s -> p99 ~11.4s, increase in 5m. Possible GPU pool exhaustion + autoscaler failing to provision. tagging oncall @maria and eng-sre.

maria (oncall): On it. Observability links?

incidents-bot: Dashboard: https://console/redwood/hosted/us-east/queues/metrics?range=5m | Provisioner logs: gs://redwood-ops/provisioner/us-east/2024-05-17.log

maria (oncall): Thanks. daniel, any recent deploys to serving runtime?

daniel (eng-runtime): No user deploys in the last hour. We're seeing many queued requests with model variant pinning heavy on gpu-pool-x. Autoscaler show errors: "quotaExceeded: instance-creation-rate-limit" repeatedly.

rod (sre): Confirming: provisioner reports 429 from cloud provider when creating GPUs. Also seeing scale hysteresis: nodes not removed cleanly so headroom low.

alyssa (eng-platform): Hysteresis details: we have scale-down delay set to 10m to avoid oscillation. But scale-up limits: concurrent-create=2 and provider rate limit 1/s. Spike saturates both.

jen (support): We have customers reporting timeouts and 504s. Ticket triage shows 3 mid-tier enterprise customers affected. Escalating to AE.

ev an (ops): Can we temporarily open fallback routing to CPU-backed variant for best-effort traffic? That would reduce GPU pressure.

daniel (eng-runtime): We can enable fallback-per-route. Suggest: route non-SL A customers to cpu-micro-2 variant, keep enterprise on pinned GPU models. Will require a quick config flip.

maria (oncall): Do it. daniel, please make the change and post config snippet. I'll update customers.

daniel (eng-runtime): Applying: 
```
route-config set hosted://default -> fallback:cpu-micro-2
constraint: exclude: customer_tier==enterprise
```
Applying now...

deploy-bot: Deploy started for route-config (id: cfg-20240517-77).

daniel (eng-runtime): Done. Fallback enabled. Queues dropping from 4.2k -> 1.1k in 3m, p99 down to ~4.2s.

rod (sre): Good. Still seeing some create failures; provider quota needs follow-up. Open ticket with cloud quota: INC-3241 assigned to eng-platform. alyssa, can you take?

alyssa (eng-platform): Taking INC-3241. Also increasing concurrent-create to 4 as a short-term mitigation; will monitor impact.

jen (support): Notifying impacted customers: update sent. Some want ETA — we should give conservative 1-2hr recovery window.

maria (oncall): Handoff note: I'll stay on till stabilization at +1hr. If backlog <200 and p99 <1.5s, we'll close pager. Assigning next oncall: @evan.

ev an (ops): Acknowledged. I'll watch provisioning and routing. If quota remains blocked, we'll coordinate a region-failover to us-west as last resort.

mark (product): Keep us posted on customer impact. We'll pause non-critical experiments that route to hosted on us-east.

incidents-bot: Incident created: hosted-backlog-hysteresis-1766554321 | severity: P1 | owners: eng-runtime, eng-platform, oncall.

maria (oncall): Summary posted to incident channel and customer comms draft ready. Moving to monitoring — last update in 10m. :thumbsup:
